slides.label: TERM 01 / 03
slides.title: LLM
slides.subtitle: Large language model
slides.text:
The engine behind AI chatbots.
It learned from huge amounts of text
and predicts the likeliest next words.

slides.label: TERM 02 / 03
slides.title: AI agent
slides.subtitle: AI that acts, not just answers
slides.text:
It carries out tasks for you,
step by step: searching, booking,
filling in forms.

slides.label: TERM 03 / 03
slides.title: Hallucination
slides.subtitle: When AI makes things up
slides.text:
An AI can state something false
with total confidence.
slides.tip:
Always double-check
the facts that matter.
